# Tossy

> A fast, native macOS file transformation utility. Just toss your files in and get them out in whatever format you need.

Tossy handles everyday formats like HEIC, MP4, and MP3 as well as RAW camera files, MKV, WebM, FLAC, AVIF, JPEG XL, animated GIFs, animated WebP, and dozens more. It uses GPU-accelerated Core Image (Metal) and hardware VideoToolbox encoding where Apple's own frameworks support it, and falls back to a bundled, self-contained copy of ffmpeg for everything else. Every conversion runs locally; no file is ever uploaded to a server. Free and open source under GPL-3.0.
